svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: one child's winter kit
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs. Bars for one child's winter kit: a made-up new pre-tax total of $260, a made-up used mix of $127, and $239.20 after subtracting Ontario's 8 percent provincial HST portion from the new pre-tax total. The 8 percent is the only tax rate applied. GST is not in the bars.
svg.text: Example with made-up inputs: one child's kit
Pre-tax made-up prices. The only rate applied is Ontario's 8 percent provincial portion.
The third bar subtracts the rebate from the pre-tax total. It is not a tax-in price. GST is not shown.
The 8 percent applies only to pieces that meet Ontario's size rules. Adult sizes are excluded.
Saving Optimizer. Example with made-up inputs. Ontario page updated 19 Mar 2025. As of 29 Sep 2026.
